title: Reject add-on eligibility with invalid collection timing
prompt:
Fix false add-on eligibility when collection timing cannot be established. Change only lib/ohworks-add-on-test-window.ts and add tests/ohworks-add-on-invalid-time.test.ts. Evidence: lib/ohworks-add-on-test-window.ts:82 subtracts unchecked Date.parse results, and line 91 only compares elapsed hours with the stability limit. NaN bypasses that comparison. Reproduced with specimenStatus=available, collectedAt=garbage, a valid now, stabilityHoursForAnalyte=24, remainingVolumeMicroliters=500, requiredVolumeMicroliters=100, and requiresMinimumBufferMicroliters=50: eligible=true, status=eligible, hoursSinceCollection=NaN, and no issues. The order-intake demo uses this evaluator to describe add-on decisions.

Before deciding eligibility for an available specimen, validate collection and evaluation timestamps as real ISO calendar instants, retaining valid Z and explicit-offset forms. Reject impossible dates, unparseable timestamps, and evaluation times preceding collection with a deterministic RangeError containing a fixed, privacy-safe message. Do not extend the status union or change display components. Preserve the existing unavailable-specimen short circuit and valid stability/volume decisions.

Test malformed timestamps in each position, February 30, future collection, a valid leap day, equivalent offset instants, and the exact stability boundary. Assert invalid available specimens never yield eligible outcomes. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks-add-on-invalid-time.test.ts. The planner reproduced the defect; 140 existing focused tests passed, and PR duplicate checks found no overlap. work on the assigned branch you are on. Edit only the named files; no credentials, persistence, or external operations.
